name: nnterp
description: Architecture-agnostic interpretability with nnterp on nnsight 0.8 - one module vocabulary and standard values (layer_output, attention_output, attention_probabilities, ...) across 98 transformer families, the vision side of vision-language wrappers (model.vision, the tower blocks, the projector, image_token_mask, image_features), recipes written once for every family, and adding or overriding a family
